en.title: Find Repetitions
en.description:
Given a pattern string short_s and a text long_s, find the maximum number of times short_s repeats consecutively in long_s. No other characters may appear between occurrences. If either string is empty, the answer is 0.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: Two lines of uppercase English letters: the first line is short_s and the second is long_s, with lengths 0..9 and 0..999999 respectively. An empty string is given as an empty line.
en.output: Output the maximum number of consecutive repetitions.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
